lines.text: Six games, twelve awards, one Christmas party. Start with a mingle game as guests arrive. Trivia and charades in teams. Build gingerbread houses, and judge them. Swap gifts with a dice game. Then hand out the awards. Sixteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

Hosting Friendsgiving this year? Seven games for a table full of friends. A potluck sign-up, so nobody brings the same dish. Trivia, bingo, and Most Likely To. Thankful toast cards for the table. Fifteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
